overview.about: The Tour Championship is the season-ending finale of the PGA Tour's FedExCup Playoffs, contested by only the top 30 players at East Lake Golf Club in Atlanta. The winner is crowned FedExCup champion and takes home one of the largest bonuses in sport.
overview.nextEvent: The next Tour Championship is played at East Lake Golf Club in Atlanta with a field of just 30. The player who comes out on top lifts the FedExCup and its enormous season-long bonus.
